sources.title: Iraq Ministry of Foreign Affairs: obtaining an entry visa upon arrival
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Iraq
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Iraqi Foreign Ministry consular page expressly includes European Union passports in its arrival-visa cohort, describes issuance at land, air and sea crossings, and separately advises eVisa use.
sources.supportingExcerpt: European Union countries ... are granted a visa to Iraq upon arrival through the border crossings.

policies.title: Estonian ordinary passports: Panama short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Current Estonian Foreign Ministry guidance permits Estonian citizens to visit Panama visa-free for up to 180 days.
conditions: Ordinary Estonian passport holder, short visitor stay of up to 180 days.
Residence, work, special passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Estonian ordinary passports: Tunisia short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Current Estonian Foreign Ministry guidance permits Estonian citizens to visit Tunisia visa-free for up to 90 days in six months.
conditions: Ordinary Estonian passport holder, short visitor stay of up to 90 days in six months.
Work, residence, special passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Estonian ordinary passports: Ukraine short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Current Estonian Foreign Ministry guidance records visa-free short stays in Ukraine for ordinary Estonian passport holders.
conditions: Ordinary Estonian passport holder, short visitor stay of up to 90 days in 180 days.
The current travel warning, dual-Ukrainian-national treatment, residence, work, special passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Estonian ordinary passports: Iraq visitor visa issued at arrival
policies.summary: Iraq's current Foreign Ministry guidance includes European Union passports in its visitor visa-on-arrival cohort, which therefore includes ordinary Estonian passports.
conditions: Ordinary Estonian passport holder; the visa is issued at Iraqi land, air or sea border crossings and is stated as valid for 60 days.
Iraq separately advises, but does not require in place of this route, pre-travel eVisa use. Work, residence, special passports and final admission remain separate.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback labels Iraq eVisa, but Iraq's current Foreign Ministry explicitly grants the named European Union passport cohort a visa at arrival; its separate eVisa advice does not eliminate border issuance.
